summary: 4U accelerator-optimized ProLiant Compute DL380a Gen12 for AI inference, with Intel Xeon 6 processors.

value: HPE iLO 6 on the 8DW CTO server (P74461-B21), not upgradable to iLO 7
HPE iLO 7 on the 8DW/16SW CTO server (P76706-B21)

processors.note: Partial extract of the QuickSpecs Intel Xeon 6 table. The product page summarizes the platform as up to 144 cores at 250 W; the QuickSpecs table also lists 144-core 6780E at 330 W.

value.populationNote: 6700-series E-core CPUs limit DIMM quantities per CPU to 1, 2, 4, 8, and 16. 6500/6700 P-core CPUs allow 1, 2, 4, 8, 12, and 16.

value.chassis: 10 double-wide GPU chassis with one drive bay
value.defaultDriveCage: One 4SFF x4 U.3 NVMe drive cage

value.productPage: Up to 16 single-wide NVIDIA L4, or 10 double-wide L40S, H100 NVL, H200, or 8 double-wide RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs

options.description: Double-wide GPU population cited by the QuickSpecs

accelerators.note: The product page and QuickSpecs describe different maximum populations. Both are recorded. No single GPU TDP was extracted, so accelerator TDP is not used for power planning.

networking.note: PCIe 5.0 is stated. A NIC option table was not extracted.

value.domains: Three power domains, two of which have six power supplies dedicated to GPUs
value.note: System planning watts were not published in the extracted pages. Do not sum GPU marketing counts into a rack load.

firmwareBaseline.reason: No firmware, BIOS, or driver version is included in the starter dataset.

referenceConfigurations.title: Up to 10 double-wide GPUs in the 4U chassis
referenceConfigurations.note: Published maximum from the QuickSpecs overview. Not a firmware baseline and not a complete bill of materials.
